name: zanker-visual-brainstorm
description: Serve multiple design explorations and collect user selections locally.

workflow.instruction: Create a concepts.json with 2-3 visual directions; HTML/CSS concepts allowed.
User opens URL and selects or comments; inspect .zanker/studio/events-*.jsonl.
Translate approved direction into implementation plan; concepts are not production code.

fallback: Render static alternatives or image references if interactive preview unavailable.
